answer: Phase-Locked Traffic Attestation: each identity gets a verifier-seeded schedule of short bursts—a yarrow-like sparse pulse train—inside recurring grove windows. Over a multi-week horizon, it must match inter-burst timing, jitter, and silent gaps within tolerance; verifiers cross-correlate burst envelopes across identities. Faking N sybils requires N independent clocks/network paths and sustained distinct timing distributions, because multiplexed bots produce correlated envelopes and get pruned. Attacker cost: N× long-lived infrastructure plus jitter calibration; cheap duplication fails.
